title: DreamFusion: Text-to-3D using 2D Diffusion
layout_note: Left half: a 3-D render chain (density and albedo cubes in a NeRF panel, then normals, shading and colour cubes, then a camera viewing the colour cube). Right half: the rendering is noised and passed through a frozen diffusion panel, and the noise residual returns along a long arrow at the bottom that runs back to the NeRF panel, closing the loop.
grouping: Two tinted rounded panels name the two models: a pink panel (labelled NeRF in a white tag, with the MLP name) holds the density and albedo cubes, and a cyan panel (labelled Imagen in a white tag) holds the text prompt, frozen text encoder and U-Net. The bottom return arrow is filled with a pink-to-cyan gradient, joining the two panel colours.
shapes_depth: Every 3-D quantity is a thin grey wireframe cube holding a rendered object coloured by that quantity (rainbow density, albedo, normals, grey shading, final colour). Light is a yellow sun icon with a yellow band arrow; the camera is a small dark camera glyph with grey frustum lines to a tilted image plane. Images are square photo tiles: the rendering, Gaussian noise, noised latent, denoised output and the residual. Network parts are 3-D extruded block shapes (Transformer slab, U-Net wedge) with padlock icons for frozen weights. Flow arrows are broad flat light-grey block arrows; labels are math under each picture.
proposed_highlight: The new training signal is the wide gradient-filled arrow labelled with its text, running the full width beneath the figure back into the NeRF panel; the pretrained model is marked as frozen by padlock icons, not by colour.
lesson: Draw each rendered quantity (density, albedo, normals, shading, colour) as its own wireframe cube holding the object coloured by that quantity, and close the loop with one long gradient-tinted return arrow whose two end colours match the two model panels it connects.
notes: venue ICLR from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); year = arXiv preprint year (2209.14988). The figure embeds many rendered and photo tiles; the measured palette is over the whole raster.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
